overall_assessment: The 28 packet entries generally contain readable, course-specific plans, but one PDF course includes a substantial programme-wide appendix and four retain standalone page numbers. Both year flags correctly identify earlier HTML plans already excluded from the build, so neither is a finding; cohort PDFs for delayed/resit offerings do not by themselves establish a wrong-year error. No other clear content loss, wrong-page extraction or structural failure is evident in the supplied material; PDF completeness cannot be compared against stored pages.

findings.description: The BIS23 BSYP-503 extract continues after its completed assessment section into programme-wide learning outcomes and statutory competence areas. Its 14,664 characters therefore include substantial material outside this course plan. The other two sampled BSYP-503 cohort extracts end at the course assessment, supporting an isolated PDF boundary failure rather than course content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/harvest_strategies.R: ldh_pdf_courses() ends a course at the next course heading, an uppercase programme heading, Referanser or Vedlegg. The mixed-case heading "Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter" does not match its uppercase stop pattern, so the final course absorbs the following programme appendix.
findings.suggested_fix: In ldh_pdf_courses(), add an anchored, case-insensitive stop heading for "Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter" when calculating course boundaries, then rebuild the LDH PDF extracts and downstream data.

findings.description: Standalone PDF page numbers interrupt otherwise readable plan text in four controls: MALSY-100 (18–20), VIB-101 (14–15), MOPSY-100 (13–15), and MOPNA-100 (16–17). Unlike the running programme/update lines explicitly listed as removed, these numbers are absent from the packet's anonymizer removal lists and remain extraction noise.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/harvest_strategies.R: ldh_pdf_courses() removes footer lines containing text followed by a separated number, but does not remove a number printed alone on its own line. LDH has no institution-specific anonymizer that strips standalone PDF page numbers.
findings.suggested_fix: In ldh_pdf_courses(), remove lines matching ^[ \t]*[0-9]{1,3}[ \t]*$ from each PDF page before concatenation, preferably restricted to the page margin/footer region, and rebuild the extracts.
